content.text: By the end of this lesson, you should be able to:
State the word and symbol equations for photosynthesis
Explain the importance of photosynthesis for life on Earth
Describe the fate of glucose produced in photosynthesis

is the process by which plants, algae, and some bacteria convert light energy into chemical energy stored in glucose. It is the fundamental process that provides food and oxygen for most life on Earth.
is the process by which plants use light energy to convert carbon dioxide and water into glucose and oxygen.
Converts inorganic molecules to organic molecules
carbon dioxide + water  →(light energy)→  glucose + oxygen
Leaves are the main photosynthetic organs
